title: landing_tickets_ahead tells a missing own ticket apart from an empty queue, so landing_lock takes its place again in the same step as the check
goal: landing_tickets_ahead returns None when the asking landing's ticket is not in the queue and landing_lock asks again at once on it, so a landing whose ticket another landing removed between the exists check and the listing never takes the lock ahead of an earlier live asker

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
qdir = bl_close.landing_queue_dir(bl_close.landing_lock_path(t))
qdir.mkdir()
out = bl_close.landing_tickets_ahead(qdir, "%020d-%d" % (1, os.getpid()))
print("landing_tickets_ahead on a queue without the asking ticket:", repr(out))
sys.exit(0 if out is None else 1)
